newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Feb crude palm oil output down 13.11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Feb crude palm oil output down 13.11 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's crude palm oil output fell 13.11 percent to 503,436 tonnes in February from 579,366 in January and against 427,877 in February 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Saturday.
February palm oil exports were 376,885 tonnes against 553,306 in January and 432,420 in February 1996, it said.
PORLA said Peninsular Malaysia's crude palm oil output fell 8.20 percent to 378,218 tonnes in February from 411,984 in January and 338,411 in February 1996.
Output from east Malaysian states of Sabah and Sarawak fell 25.19 percent to 125,218 tonnes in February from 167,382 in January and against 89,466 in February 1996.
Malaysia's palm kernel oil production fell 30.57 percent to 58,925 tonnes in February from 84,875 in January and against 59,591 in February 1996.
